name: LEDs and lights
summary: LEDs and lamps of every kind: bulbs, tubes, strips, torches, floodlights and the LEDs inside them.
uses: Light at night on very little power
12V lights run straight from a battery (strips and vehicle bulbs)
identify: Bulbs, panels and tubes in every building; 12V LED strips in cabinets, vehicles and signs; torches and headlamps in cars and drawers; solar garden lights and emergency exit signs with their own batteries. Fluorescent tubes and CFLs hold mercury: don’t break them indoors.
test: Try LED strips and 12V lamps on a battery. A meter on diode mode makes a single LED glow faintly. Try mains bulbs in a socket or on an inverter.

decay.note: LEDs last; the batteries in torches and emergency lights don’t.
